items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: I was gonna say he looks big like Zooty Singleton, but I knew it couldn't be Zooty

ctx.x: Oh, it's Sa-ee. Sa-ee. Sa-ee. Sa-ee. Sa-ee.
Yeah. I was gonna say he looks big like Zooty Singleton, but I knew it couldn't be Zooty,
so I was trying to think. Yeah, it looks like Sa-ee all right. He looks bigger then than he is now.
